from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisites: Rigidity vs. Flexibility", [
            "Geometry focuses on size, angles, and distances.", 
            "Topology ignores these, focusing on continuous deformation.", 
            "We never tear or glue objects."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display two rigid objects (cube and sphere) in #FFFFFF
        cube = Cube(side_length=1.5, fill_opacity=0.3, color=WHITE)
        sphere = Sphere(radius=0.75, fill_opacity=0.3, color=WHITE)
        
        self.place_at_grid(cube, 'B2')
        self.place_at_grid(sphere, 'B5')
        
        self.play(Create(cube), Create(sphere))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FF5733")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight rigid boundary of cube and sphere with #FF5733
        # Show deformation of sphere into a flexible blob.
        cube_boundary = Cube(side_length=1.5, stroke_color="#FF5733", fill_opacity=0, stroke_width=4)
        sphere_boundary = Sphere(radius=0.75, stroke_color="#FF5733", fill_opacity=0, stroke_width=4)
        self.place_at_grid(cube_boundary, 'B2')
        self.place_at_grid(sphere_boundary, 'B5')
        
        self.play(Create(cube_boundary), Create(sphere_boundary))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#33FF57")
        
        # Deformation of sphere
        blob = SVGMobject("blob_placeholder") if False else ParametricSurface(
            lambda u, v: np.array([
                0.75 * np.cos(u) * np.sin(v) + 0.2 * np.sin(3*u),
                0.75 * np.sin(u) * np.sin(v) + 0.2 * np.cos(3*v),
                0.75 * np.cos(v)
            ]), u_range=[0, TAU], v_range=[0, PI], color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.5
        )
        self.place_at_grid(blob, 'B5')
        self.play(Transform(sphere, blob), Transform(sphere_boundary, blob.copy().set_stroke(color="#FF5733", fill_opacity=0)))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Emphasize that rigidity is not preserved, conclusion
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#3357FF")
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

class Section1Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup Text
        title = Text("Prerequisites: Rigidity vs. Flexibility", font_size=28).to_edge(UP)
        lines = VGroup(
            Text("1. Geometry focuses on size, angles, and distances.", font_size=20),
            Text("2. Topology ignores these, focusing on continuous deformation.", font_size=20),
            Text("3. We never tear or glue objects.", font_size=20)
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        
        self.add(title)
        
        # Geometry objects
        square = Square(side_length=1.5, color=WHITE)
        circle = Circle(radius=0.75, color=WHITE)
        
        # Position objects
        square.shift(LEFT * 2)
        circle.shift(RIGHT * 2)
        
        self.play(Write(lines[0]), Create(square), Create(circle))
        self.wait(1)
        
        lines[0].set_color(ORANGE)
        lines[1].set_color(GREEN)
        self.play(Write(lines[1]))
        
        # Deformation
        # Create a blob by modifying the circle points
        blob = VMobject()
        blob.set_points(circle.get_points())
        blob.set_color(BLUE)
        
        # Create a transform path
        def get_blob_path(t):
            x = 0.75 * np.cos(t) + 0.2 * np.sin(3 * t)
            y = 0.75 * np.sin(t) + 0.2 * np.cos(3 * t)
            return np.array([x, y, 0])
        
        blob_target = VMobject()
        blob_target.set_points_smoothly([get_blob_path(t) for t in np.linspace(0, TAU, 20)])
        blob_target.move_to(circle.get_center())
        blob_target.set_color(BLUE)
        
        self.play(Transform(circle, blob_target))
        
        lines[2].set_color(BLUE)
        self.play(Write(lines[2]))
        
        self.wait(2)
